entry.title: Bridgeport proclamation recognizes Equity Uprise Human Rights Day
entry.summary: The City of Bridgeport issued a proclamation for Equity Uprise Human Rights Day on December 10, 2025.

entry.title: Georgia proclamation designates Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week
entry.summary: A State of Georgia proclamation signed October 27, 2025 designates December 12-18, 2025 as Georgia Youth Innovation & Civic Leadership Week.
